mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment; amikacin is an aminoglycoside with known dose-dependent nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity that may be potentiated by fosfomycin.
action: Monitor renal function closely (serum creatinine, BUN) and adjust aminoglycoside dosing accordingly; ensure adequate hydration and consider this combination only when benefits outweigh risks.
